takeaways: OneLake is a single logical data lake per tenant, built on Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and delivered as a SaaS service, where every Fabric workload stores its data in open Delta Parquet format.

The OneCopy principle lets Spark, SQL and Power BI read the same physical data, while shortcuts reference external data in place and mirroring replicates databases in near real time without pipelines.

Lakehouse, Warehouse and Eventhouse are different views over the same storage, governed by one security model with workspace roles, OneLake security roles, the OneLake catalog and Purview integration.
hook: Most organizations store the same customer and sales data four or five times, and nobody trusts which report is right. This episode explains Microsoft Fabric OneLake for data engineers, analysts and Power BI users: the OneCopy principle, shortcuts, mirroring, the three data stores and a single security model.
